source.title: Untapped Forbidden Knowledge — original comment on disenchanting an upgraded/catalyzed Primal Storm item
source.author: amareck

quote: I only tested it on one item and it gave me Vibrant Shards
notes: One firsthand, self-selected POSITIVE disenchant of one upgraded/catalyzed Dragonflight gear piece; exact gear item ID, slot, quality, item-level, character skill/spec, game build, timing, amount of Vibrant Shards and any other simultaneously produced materials are NOT reported. The page refers to plate girdle and cloth boots elsewhere, but DOES NOT identify which item the commenter disenchanted: do not attribute to either item. One reported positive anecdote is not a zero-inclusive outcome sample and MUST NOT establish a baseline P(hit), cast histogram, or source-rank-specific yield. Same English comment appears across locale mirrors; only one original event here.
inputName: Unspecified upgraded or catalyzed Dragonflight Primal Storm gear
